## About
AAA Used Auto Sales & Parts is a used parts shop on W Chicago in Detroit, serving the Detroit metro area with quality used parts. Foreign or domestic, we'll help you find the part that fits.
We're rated 4 from 64 Google reviews. Reviewers talk about good customer service, fair prices and getting the right part for their car.

## Services
- Foreign and domestic auto parts: Used parts for both foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Quality used parts: Used parts for drivers and shops around the Detroit metro area.

## FAQ
Q: Do you carry parts for foreign cars?
A: Yes. We carry both foreign and domestic auto parts.

Q: What if you don't have my part?
A: Give us a call anyway. One reviewer said that when we didn't have her parts, we called another parts place that did.

Q: Can I look up parts before I come in?
A: Yes. Our website has an inventory search, including search by image and multi-part search.
